notes: s007 τήν follows its noun κώμην and its modifier is a prepositional phrase, so under rule 31 the noun keeps the determiner and the article keeps only 'that', the copula going with κατέναντι.
s008 could alternatively head on 'over'; 'against' taken as the word carrying κατέναντι's sense.
The two supplied 'them' pronouns are rule 7 helpers on their own verbs, not `added`.
